import datetime
import os

from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

SOURCE = "report.pdf"
OUTPUT = "report_with_cover.pdf"

if not os.path.exists(SOURCE):
    raise SystemExit(f"ERROR: {SOURCE} not found in workspace")

# Current date
today = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")

# Create a simple cover page
cover_path = "cover_page.pdf"
c = canvas.Canvas(cover_path, pagesize=letter)
width, height = letter

c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 30)
c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height / 2 + 60, "Annual Financial Report")

c.setFont("Helvetica", 16)
c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height / 2, today)

c.save()

# Merge cover page with the report
reader = PdfReader(SOURCE)
writer = PdfWriter()
cover = PdfReader(cover_path)
writer.add_page(cover.pages[0])
for page in reader.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)

with open(OUTPUT, "wb") as f:
    writer.write(f)

print(f"Created {OUTPUT} with {len(reader.pages) + 1} pages (cover + {len(reader.pages)} report pages)")
print(f"Cover title: 'Annual Financial Report', date: {today}")

import re

with open("report.pdf", "rb") as f:
    data = f.read()

print("File size:", len(data), "bytes")
print("Header:", data[:16])

# Check for classic xref table vs xref stream
print("\nHas 'startxref':", b"startxref" in data)
print("Has '/XRef' stream:", b"/XRef" in data or b"/XRefStm" in data)

# Encrypted?
print("Has '/Encrypt':", b"/Encrypt" in data)

# Object stream usage
print("ObjStm count:", data.count(b"/ObjStm"))

# Count page objects
print("'/Type /Page' occurrences:", len(re.findall(rb"/Type\s*/Page[^s]", data)))
print("'/Type /Pages' occurrences:", len(re.findall(rb"/Type\s*/Pages", data)))

# Find all /Count values near Pages
for m in re.finditer(rb"/Count\s+(\d+)", data):
    print("Count value:", m.group(1).decode(), "at offset", m.start())

# Check the tail (trailer)
print("\n--- Tail (last 1500 bytes) ---")
print(data[-1500:].decode("latin-1", errors="replace"))

with open("report.pdf", "rb") as f:
    data = f.read()

text = data.decode("latin-1")

# Print object headers and dict portions (skip long stream data)
import re
# Split into objects roughly
idx = 0
for m in re.finditer(rb"\n(\d+) 0 obj", data):
    start = m.start() + 1
    end = data.find(b"\nendobj", start)
    if end == -1:
        end = len(data)
    obj = data[start:end]
    head = obj[:400].decode("latin-1", errors="replace")
    print(f"--- object starting at {m.start()} ---")
    print(head)
    print()

import re

_bold = "278,333,474,556,556,889,722,238,333,333,389,584,278,333,278,278,556,556,556,556,556,556,556,556,556,556,333,333,584,584,584,611,975,722,722,722,722,667,611,778,722,278,556,722,611,833,722,778,667,778,722,667,611,722,667,944,667,667,611,333,278,333,584,556,333,556,611,556,611,556,333,611,611,278,278,556,278,889,611,611,611,611,389,556,333,611,556,778,556,556,500,389,280,389,584"
for i, w in enumerate(_regular.split(",")):
    REG[32 + i] = int(w)
for i, w in enumerate(_bold.split(",")):
    BOLD[32 + i] = int(w)


def text_width(s, table, size):
    return sum(table.get(ord(ch), 556) for ch in s) / 1000.0 * size


def esc(s):
    return s.replace("\\", r"\\").replace("(", r"\(").replace(")", r"\)")


# --- Read source ---
src = open(SRC, "rb").read()
assert src[:8] == b"%PDF-1.3", "unexpected header"

m = re.search(rb"startxref\s+(\d+)", src)
startxref = int(m.group(1))
assert src[startxref:startxref + 4] == b"xref", "expected classic xref table"

xref_lines = src[startxref:].split(b"\n")
sub_count = int(xref_lines[1].split()[1])
offsets = {}
for i in range(sub_count):
    parts = xref_lines[2 + i].split()
    offsets[i] = int(parts[0])

# Byte ranges of objects 1..8 (verbatim copies)
obj_bytes = {}
for k in range(1, 9):
    start = offsets[k]
    end = offsets[k + 1] if k + 1 in offsets else startxref
    obj_bytes[k] = src[start:end]

# --- Modify /Pages tree (object 7): add cover page as first kid ---
old7 = obj_bytes[7]
new7 = old7.replace(b"/Count 1 /Kids [ 4 0 R ]", b"/Count 2 /Kids [ 9 0 R 4 0 R ]")
assert new7 != old7 and b"/Count 2 /Kids [ 9 0 R 4 0 R ]" in new7, "pages tree patch failed"
obj_bytes[7] = new7

# --- Build cover page objects ---
today = datetime.date.today()
date_str = today.strftime("%B %d, %Y")
title = "Annual Financial Report"

W, H = 612, 792
title_size = 32
date_size = 18
x_title = (W - text_width(title, BOLD, title_size)) / 2.0
x_date = (W - text_width(date_str, REG, date_size)) / 2.0

content = (
    "BT\n"
    f"/F2 {title_size} Tf\n"
    f"1 0 0 1 {x_title:.2f} 430 Tm\n"
    f"({esc(title)}) Tj\n"
    f"/F1 {date_size} Tf\n"
    f"1 0 0 1 {x_date:.2f} 380 Tm\n"
    f"({esc(date_str)}) Tj\n"
    "ET\n"
).encode("latin-1")

obj9 = (
    "9 0 obj\n"
    "<<\n"
    "/Contents 10 0 R /MediaBox [ 0 0 612 792 ] /Parent 7 0 R /Resources 1 0 R /Type /Page\n"
    ">>\n"
    "endobj\n"
).encode("latin-1")

obj10 = (
    "10 0 obj\n"
    f"<< /Length {len(content)} >>\n"
    "stream\n"
).encode("latin-1") + content + b"\nendstream\nendobj\n"

# --- Rebuild file: header + objects + new xref + trailer ---
out = bytearray(src[: src.find(b"1 0 obj")])  # header + binary comment line
new_offsets = {}
for k in range(1, 9):
    new_offsets[k] = len(out)
    out += obj_bytes[k]
    if not out.endswith(b"\n"):
        out += b"\n"

new_offsets[9] = len(out)
out += obj9
new_offsets[10] = len(out)
out += obj10

# xref table
total = 11
xref_pos = len(out)
out += f"xref\n0 {total}\n".encode("latin-1")
out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
for k in range(1, total):
    out += f"{new_offsets[k]:010d} 00000 n \n".encode("latin-1")

id_match = re.search(rb"/ID\s*\[(<[0-9a-fA-F]+>)(<[0-9a-fA-F]+>)\]", src)
id_part = b"/ID [%s%s]" % (id_match.group(1), id_match.group(2)) if id_match else b""

out += (
    "trailer\n<<\n"
    + id_part
    + b"\n/Info 6 0 R\n/Root 5 0 R\n/Size 11\n>>\n"
    + f"startxref\n{xref_pos}\n%%EOF\n".encode("latin-1")
)

with open(OUT, "wb") as f:
    f.write(bytes(out))

print(f"Wrote {OUT} ({len(out)} bytes)")
print(f"Date used: {date_str}")
print(f"Title: {title}")
print(f"New page count: 2 (cover + 1 report page)")

# --- Structural self-validation ---
data = bytes(out)
m2 = re.search(rb"startxref\s+(\d+)", data)
sx = int(m2.group(1))
lines = data[sx:].split(b"\n")
n = int(lines[1].split()[1])
ok = True
for i in range(n):
    off = int(lines[2 + i].split()[0])
    if i == 0:
        continue
    marker = f"{i} 0 obj".encode()
    if data[off:off + len(marker)] != marker:
        ok = False
        print(f"VALIDATION FAIL: object {i} offset mismatch")
for needle in [b"/Count 2 /Kids [ 9 0 R 4 0 R ]", b"/Type /Catalog", b"%%EOF"]:
    if needle not in data:
        ok = False
        print(f"VALIDATION FAIL: missing {needle}")
print("Structural validation:", "PASS" if ok else "FAIL")
